body.contents: Hello, and Welcome to the Wizarding World! To get started on your adventure, craft yourself a Wand!
You can choose any wand core and any overworld STRIPPED WOOD (specifically. EX: stripped_oak_wood). Then throw your items onto a Wand Crafting Table
All recipes can be found in the Field Guide book provided, or in the Crafting Table Recipe Book
Thank You for downloading! If you have any questions, look on the modrinth page or join my discord!
